newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies seven muni issues for insurance. [CORRECTED 15:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies seven muni issues for insurance. [CORRECTED 15:25 GMT]

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal bond issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Coon Rapids, Minn. (Corrects from Iowa), $4.525 million general obligation improvement bonds.
--Laurel, M.D., $13.255 million public improvement refunding bonds.
--Lacey Township Board of Ed, N.J., $16.790 million school bonds.
--Harris County MUD #102, Texas, $1.475 million water and sewer revenue bonds.
--Utah Building Ownership, Utah, $16.86 million lease revenue bonds.
